text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One big change is automation. Machines can now do repetitive tasks, like sorting data or answering simple customer questions. This saves time and money for companies. There are also new productivity tools that help workers plan their day, write emails faster, or organise meetings. Many people worry about losing their jobs, and it is true that some roles are disappearing. However, new jobs are appearing too. The most important change is human-AI collaboration. Instead of replacing people, AI often works beside them, helping them do their jobs better and faster. Workers now need to learn new skills to keep up.
